overviewHtml:
New users of Configuration as Code need a small, working project to follow along with the documentation. This sample is a safe place to practice before touching real configuration.

What you get

  • Reference project for the Deploy your first configuration guide
  • Monaco manifest and an auto-tag configuration
  • A delete file to remove what you deployed
  • Minimal setup: your environment URL and an API token
getStartedHtml:
1. Set your environment URL in the manifest file
  2. Export your API token as an environment variable
  3. Deploy the project with Monaco
